ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface, excluding background water.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region (RGB >240). Contiguous black border (RGB <40) along the trailing edge and tips. Three distinct low-intensity circular spots located in the lower-central medial region of the left lobe and two in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 50-55 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (5-20 pixel amplitude) extending across the entire trailing edge boundary, with extreme vertical jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves fitted to the trailing edge, transitioning to convex curves at the leading edge/tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) distributed sparsely across the white field; notable cluster of three at the center-medial zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey linear streaks oriented vertically on the mid-right lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly prominent and protruding on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of deep, irregular U-shaped notches on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, deviating from the standard serration pattern.
